reviews.text: It's okay, but it's kind of boring. There is nothing really "cool" to find in the mines, and the fact that you have to level up between games to get better means you have to play the same map repeatedly to progress. I guess it's fine if the core gameplay is good, but there's just nothing to do. You just hope to get some random technology that has a button you can press; otherwise, you're just watching... I don't like that you can't save the game. You have to finish a game before you can leave. Why?

好玩，上头，就是两个熔岩块在一起的时候，笨比矿工不会在没熔岩的那一边采矿，一定要踩在熔岩块上给我血压整上来了，血亏几个蓝矿。 这个公司真的不把员工当人看，解雇了是直接把员工粉碎掉，好残忍，弄得我有点不敢乱雇人了，上班要被虫虫追杀，解雇还要被公司粉碎。放心，在我手里你们一个不会死！ ------------------------------------------------------------- 已经遇到bug了，运输兵被冻住解开以后，全部都在矿洞里一动不动，全部撤退也没反应，最后到了晚上被地虫撞死，只能一个一个解雇，直接就没法玩了。
这种杀时间的游戏怎么能没有窗口模式呢？赶快增加窗口模式啊！！最好再加个图鉴功能！
同质化太严重，很多炮塔和建筑换个皮就放上来了，而且炮台连个优先级都不能设置，本来想退款的，结果不小心瞟到一眼科技树，原来炮台优先级是个技能点可以学，那就不退了，毕竟没人在乎我的看法
希望挖矿ai能改一改，碰到个上下喷火的熔岩快，本来是为了挖掉旁边的方块再去挖熔岩块，结果矿工站在熔岩块上挖旁边的方块，为了挖这个方块死了7-8个工人

看我时间，差不多40小时升级完全部科技树+全部任务+爬到难度10。不过游戏目前EA只有俩地图，目前应该不会再继续了，等后续出了新机体+新地图再回来玩。 [h2]先说结论：挺好玩的。但是前提是，别当成纯塔防来玩[/h2] 前期科技树不满的情况下当塔防来玩会很难受。 这个游戏塔防元素只是外壳，本质上是即时策略/模拟类，塔的搭配其实没有那么重要，运营和微操才是胜负手。 至于被很多人诟病的难度问题，我打下来其实没感觉到有什么难度，除了为了满足任务条件刷过几次，其他基本上什么难度都基本一次过。 核心问题还是在于，这个游戏主玩其实是运营和微操。不要浪费夜晚的时间直接空过，看蠕虫位置不断转移挖矿。建议是夜晚尽量不带搬运工，让全部矿工集中在一起，方便不断转移。实际上夜晚时间利用的好，甚至有时候能赶上一整个白天的时间。炮塔里混一点减速、击晕或者护盾都比单纯爆输出更好，因为输出慢=更长的夜晚时间=更长的发育时间。前两天也不要爆太多塔，2输出塔足够，基地掉点血也是在拖延时间换发育。 基本上夜晚利用的好，前期科技树不满的情况下应该是3天下第二层（第4天白天），后期科技树满了需要2天下一层。达不到这个速度说明你没利用好夜晚时间。快速下层争取到的时间非常关键，不需要的资源其实没必要捡（蓝红是基本资源，罐装的是蓝图，然后煤炭，除此之外其他拿不下不要也行）。当然，科技满之后其实难度减了很多，对微操的需求不那么重要了。慢个半天一天的也随便过。 然后就是被诟病的AI逻辑。目前AI的逻辑感觉是个指令栈，而不是选择最近的矿工。比如你刚加了一条新的指令是去挖A点隔壁的B点，这个指令会变成栈顶端变成优先级最高，然后会选择有空的矿工过来，哪怕那个矿工离B点十万八千里而B点旁边就有另一个矿工。这种逻辑确实蠢得有点离谱，选项里可以选择替换AI，这样会变成选择最近的矿工而不是按指令栈优先级。虽然能解决一部分问题，但这个AI还是简陋得有点太离谱了。 优点： 1，即时策略+塔防还算比较有新意的玩法，融合的也还不错。单纯的塔防已经无法吸引我了，买这个游戏也是冲着挖矿来的。 2，夜晚的随机事件很丰富，很需求玩家即时的反应，这也意味着高难度下如果一直加速很容易暴毙，需要耐心玩。虽然很多人吐槽事件负面太多，但这点在我这里反而是加分。 3，美术音乐都特别有卖相，片头动画的仿fleischer复古橡皮管风格好评，背景文本也有点意思。整个制作完成度很高。 缺点： 1，白天技能建筑的平衡性问题太大了。迷你钻和雷达无脑强，然后运输无人机和激光器也能用，其他都是什么垃圾。虽然炮塔和夜间建筑也多少有点不平衡，但没有白天建筑这么离谱。这里面废物太多了。 2，怪的种类过少。基本上超过10天之后怪就彻底没变化了，虽然塔防对这游戏不是第一位，但也不能太糊弄吧。 3，岩浆和冰汽方块的朝向经常卡住地图唯一经过点，真的是特别恶心的设计（论为什么迷你钻是神）。难10甚至有大量4个朝向的岩浆和冰汽，就是完全不让你过，难以想象没有迷你钻和激光器要怎么玩。多朝向以及卡住唯一路口的频率太离谱了。 总体来说，瑕不掩瑜吧。喜欢运营和微操的玩家可以无脑入，不喜欢操作的纯塔防玩家说实话不推荐，建议先去下个demo体验一下再考虑要不要买。

我认为这是一个受 Dome Keeper 启发做出来的游戏，比 Dome Keeper 更有趣。虽然有一些平衡性问题，但我觉得会慢慢完善。 看到那么多差评，大多批评的不对。其实哪些落石、喷火块、地龙等等，通过合理的规划挖掘次序都是可以回避的。我认为这些都是设计好的玩法。 工人的 AI 虽然笨，但是所有的行为都是确定的，可以通过设置取消任务点微操控制。如果未来加入更直接的控制方法或许更好一点。 游戏的难度曲线有点问题，但高难度下的游戏体验是我很喜欢的。比如，会玩之后，前几天的晚上都是不需要召回工人的，这样才能在高难度模式下最大化收益。

作为一个顶级模拟经营游戏苦手，每次哪怕仅仅是看周围的朋友游玩《缺氧》，笔者就开始张大嘴巴，准备输出一波真心实意的彩虹屁，笔者每当看到那繁琐的教程和繁琐的诸多建筑装置就开始头疼绝望，以至于在数次尝试无果之后直接将这类游戏划分到了笔者的禁区中。而本作则是一款将模拟经营要素缩减到极致的肉鸽+塔防+半模拟经营游戏。 作为一款融合了诸多元素的塔防类游戏，本作中玩家要扮演一位领导着挖矿小队前去开采资源的钻核公司经理，游戏中玩家不仅需要布置各种防御塔，还要建设各种建筑增加挖掘的速度或是人数，直到收集到一定程度的矿石玩家才可以进入到下一个阶段，游戏单局游戏的流程较长，内容较为丰富，值得喜欢的玩家一试。 太长不看版购买指南 塔防+肉鸽+模拟经营+挖矿，要素非常多 单局游戏流程较长，建筑物平衡做的稍显一般 玩法较为独特，潜力较大 汉化部分像机翻，但是居然有质量不低的中配 这年头，谁还不是个黑奴了呢？ 不得不说，本作的潜力绝对是非常大的，本作可以说完美的将数种要素融合到了游戏当中，玩家每天白天要操纵员工在地底挖矿，采集足够的资源来建造建筑或是炮塔抵御晚上袭来的虫巢。而积攒够一定的资源之后，玩家就可以启动钻井平台继续向下挖掘，挖掘一定次数之后即可完成任务。而晚上袭来的虫巢如果打破了玩家的钻井核心，就会宣告游戏失败。 游戏的操作其实并不算复杂，但是因为一些设定大大增加了其操作的上限。游戏中白天挖矿结束之后，晚上玩家可以选择全部撤离或是一个个员工单独安排撤离，而这些员工分为挖矿的，搬运者和守卫，游戏中的搬运者和守卫的行动轨迹都是不确定的，换而言之玩家是没有办法操纵其移动。而在晚上地底会出现大量庞大虫族的情况下，可以一定程度操作的挖矿人员，无疑让游戏有了可操作的空间，玩家可以双击一个地块，然后所有的挖矿人员就会一起采集这个矿石，一次来实现躲避虫族的操作。 而在收集完资源之后，玩家会随着流程的推进获得新的建筑的蓝图，玩家选择之后即可在家园中建造这些建筑，这些建筑分为攻击类，加成类，以及产出类。除此之外玩家还要在上方的墙壁两边建造各种炮台，随着流程的推进玩家能建造炮台的区域也越来越多。游戏中的建筑可简单的分为白天类和夜晚类，简单来说白天类就是用于挖矿方面的加成，而夜晚类则是防守方面的加成。 但是稍显遗憾的是游戏中虽然建筑数量很多，但是一些建筑的平衡性做的并不是很好，而炮台也有着同样的问题，一个高价位炮台的描述显然和实用起来相差甚远。 总结 有着很大潜力的肉鸽作品，值得喜欢的玩家一试。 [quote]关注「 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44066492//]来者不拒鉴游组」 [/url] [/quote] [u][b] 做最真实的评测，用心为玩家推荐 [/b][/u]
个人评价7/10分。游戏本身玩法没问题，但EA阶段，可选行星只有两个，怪物种类单调，数值平衡性很低，可重复游玩体验不佳。期待后续能够改进。

看着像是塔防加挖矿，实际就是个挖矿rogue，建议6矿4搬运深耕难3冰洞图就好了。因为越往下越往后，你就会发现守卫除了帮你拉怪其实没什么屁用。塔呢，除了激光、311、霰弹也没什么屁用，起码那个屁迫击炮升到满级也还是个ff，关键是科技里面关于塔的升级就那一个，而且也只是能让塔升级射速，那有什么用？更快的飞针吗？别搞笑了，深入到200多米，如果不是霰弹射程有限，根本没必要拿其它塔了。最关键的是，往下150米后，最上面两层的塔基是41分布的，那不是狗屎吗？你什么塔能单防一侧的怪？ 冰洞图比多岩石图简单的原因就是没有boss，起码前200米能靠基地血量苟住，“等霰弹塔防线建立了，一切都会好起来的”。 无论是解锁新塔要玩更高难度，更大的随机池让好用的塔出现几率降低，升级科技看起来更像是在挤牙膏，一局起码要半个小时的时长，还是没有图鉴全靠多死多送理解地图的方式，无不在告诉你，玩多了会腻。
目前最高难度多洞穴星球以下500米，游戏完全没有平衡，究极折磨，你三面喷火砖我也捏着鼻子认了，最高难度出四面喷火是几个意思？这是人能想出来的？一百米之后虫卵一次爆两只虫子，蠕虫活动事件直接双倍，制作组只会堆数量是吧？炮塔，建筑看似数量多，但是无法形成bd联动，能用的没几个，在加上矿工的寻路AI极端智障，专治低血压，建议大家多去最高难度耍耍，不能只有我一个人坐牢。

重复性的肝，而且每局游戏并没有新东西，根本不存在肉鸽，因为每局的套路都是一样的，所以选择技术就成了一件多此一举的事情，选了也不会去建造，也没钱建造，简直浪费操作。目前打到难度9，就是一遍一遍的重复之前的套路。（我的思路是把局外进入下一层自动收集所有矿的天赋点了，之后开局带雷达和无人机，叫无人机收集煤炭，速度开采煤矿后进下一层，利用天赋收集资源）

It's fun for about two hours. After that, it’s just the same repetitive gameplay. The mechanics are pretty basic. If you can get it at a 50% discount or more, it might be worth a try. There are free games that offer far more hours of fun.

So I find this hard to be recommend, and maybe it's because I'm being a bit unfair. I feel like the game has a strong base, a good potential loop. I like the management of the mine, I like telling my dudes what to do, even if it means having to wrangle gods-stupidest-♥♥♥♥♥♥♥-miners through the occasional environmental hazard (usually a falling rock) or getting the Drillers to avoid Terrabores by telling them to dig a bunch of ♥♥♥♥ up that's out of the way and cancelling the order. my main problem actually stems from the tower defence portion of this game, and some of the upgrades. So, I was on, what, difficulty 3? 4? In the Caverns? And I'm noticing a trend. Waves are taking a long time to slog through. My turrets do, basically, no damage. Yet there's *so* many of them! And they have so much health! "What the ♥♥♥♥?" I thought to myself, "how am I meant to have the damage output for this AND the crowd clear?" And then it hit me, like a round fired from a GUN 311. "Wait, the machine gun turrets are ♥♥♥♥ and I should never build them. Struggling with crowds that have a lot of health? Just build the biggest, hardest hitting turret I can." And that's what I did. I capped out on GUN 311 (hereby called Cannon because I'm tired of saying Gun311 in my head over and over and over again), and you know what? I won that run. I won that run with basically no difficulty. And then I did it again. And again. And again. And I have not failed a run since. I am now up to difficulty 7+. Oh, wow, that's a really cool turret, shame it's just worse than the Cannon. Which most turrets are. I thought the flamer might be cool, but it actually just fires a single piercing shot that applies a DOT that does... basically no damage. Now, if you're playing this game, you've probably said "But Pride Lizard, you fool, you didn't account for the jungle and the frost planet." And I would say "You're right- but actually." Yes, the Cannon Turret ALONE struggles against the frost enemies, due to their shields, and struggles against jungle enemies due to jungle enemies splitting into spores. However, all that takes is one or two machine gun turrets that are upgraded once or twice to remove the shields. Or, well, you use the machine gun turrets until you have access to DRONE MK2. This is where ♥♥♥♥ gets really silly. Imagine the machine gun turret. CHeap. A bit ♥♥♥♥. Low damage. Limited by its range, as all turrets are. Now imagine there was, say, some kind of turret that had "unlimited range" because it spawned drones that will fly up and down the shaft, target the nearest enemy, and just pelt them with machinegun fire until it explodes. Wouldn't it be really funny, and very silly, if an upgraded Drone MK2 turret had not only basically infinite range, but also spat out drones so incredibly fast that it not ONLY out DPS's the machine gun turret, but effectively becomes the best crowd clear in the game for killing weak enemies? Or stripping shields? It's even okay at killing spores, and the spores are the ONE TIME i will argue for the Rocket Turret. This is why I don't recommend it. All of the turrets just, feel bad. With the exception of Cannon (gun 311), Drone MK2, and the obligatory INCREDIBLY powerful utility turrets (Synergy for more fire rate, Weakness Beam, and Slow Beam), all my runs just become the same. I don't think there should be bad *turrets*, I just think there should be bad times to *use* a turret. Technically, Cannon is a bad turret situationally because there's a LOT of enemies. It's a shame, then, that stacking these turrets and upgrading them enough times completely mitigates the downside because high fire rate with high damage ends up being better than extremely high firerate with low damage. "You could setup a kill zone with weakness beam and mach-" Yeah, or I could do that with a ♥♥♥♥ load of cannons and a single weakness beam to ensure the cannons ALWAYS one shot weak targets, and make short work of tanks. ... Also I don't think the Dwarves are good. They mine slow, they're REALLY expensive for how slow they mine, the explosive specialisation is... eh? ESPECIALLY in comparison to the default platform. A single miner is weak and puts in less work, true, but it's pretty easy to get 6 of them and have 2 dedicated teams to breaking specific blocks quickly rather than a lot of blocks slowly. This gets sillier when you get the last upgrade for the default platform, allowing you to hire drillers that, what, drill about 2/3x faster than a standard driller? 3 of those make short work of most blocks. The passive iron generation from the Factories is also extremely helpful in the early game, meanwhile Dwarf factories are based on blocks broken - and if it takes you a long time to actually get iron in the early game... Also, it's weird you'd make an upgrade that sucks up loose materials when you use the platform to drill deeper. It means you can just ignore worker balance, where you try to balance Carriers and Miners so you're getting proper work done while having enough guards to make them safe. Instead you just have 2 carriers, with like 9 miners and just *explode* the mine. Dozens and dozens and dozens of resources collected in just a few days because you're actively *rewarded* for just ignoring things once you buy an upgrade? I don't know, I don't like that.

Too repetitive - often it's just RNG, like the resource locations, the drilling routes, and the spawning of terror worms. It gets boring too quickly

不推荐现在入，目前阶段不好玩，既然玩法是roguelike运营，本作中后期便秘的体验根本对不起前期随机性的惩罚，比运营上风暴之城差远了。炮塔的升级几乎毫无成长性，还卡死塔防数量上限恶心玩家，既然卡塔的数量，那能不能取消怪物的血量增加曲线，以及取消砖块硬度成长曲线，这俩都极大阻碍了中后期成型的爽感。几乎每局都是在矿挖不动发展受限同时夜间塔防便秘掉血受不了润的，玩了两天要不是想开天赋树根本不想开下一把。不是不可以难，晚上从蠕虫嘴里偷挖矿贪运矿很爽，核心顶着丝血反杀boss也很爽，但是资源获取（挖矿）本身太便秘了。找煤的任务也很无聊，如果能引入矿区战（比方说击杀矿区里的虫族小boss拿煤炭，或者搞无人机开地下矿区人类负责打虫甚至有和蠕虫的boss战）搞双线RTS会好玩很多。还有就是删卡池科技能不能搞上，如果官方想让玩家体验各种可以可以搞每日挑战自带XXX开局，但是平时自己开一把还要在一堆新解锁的XX里面找自己熟悉的卡真的烦（而且这XX游戏还卡刷新次数），策划要想的是如何增加玩家的正反馈而不是魏史，再搞些有的没的就等着凉吧。

体验了30多小时，目前 前三难度 用普通工人平台 都可以稳定打到300-500米以上，新出的部门炮塔也很强力，比如鱼叉炮可以完美克制大号精英怪，解决前期火力不足恐惧症。但是矮人平台设定实在是太糟糕了，原本以为可以快乐的炸矿，结果实测下来 高倍率的成本不说，前期死2个矮人直接导致经济停摆。另外一不留意就会触发一直无限原地炸。普通工人平台已经拉满体验挺好，但是矮人玩了3把弃了2把 实在玩不下去搞心态。希望以后处理好矮人无限空炸的问题。并且增加过得有趣的平台部门和系统。

Edit: I gave the game another chance but no - the game is really boring in its mechanic. This is a 3/10 game because it is mind numbingly boring. It's a collect 13 ore to increase the turret range by +2% and then send +10 red crystal to company to be able to make the enemies go 3% slower. Then you have to collect special purple ore that, only at level 8, will allow you to start the missions with +1 green ore. It's a stat game with boring enemies, boring turrets, VERY boring buildings and only 3 types of workers. During the day phase, you have to micromanage your dumb workers and then you have to constantly look at the 6 different "events" that are buffing or nerfing your mission or day to build the correct towers or buildings. There's just too much of everything and you don't feel any progression or innovation from level to level because the progression is +5% here and +1 there. Plus, I suspect AI was used for graphics and for the perks logic... I regret giving it another go.

MAJOR ANNOYANCE: END OF DAY RECALL SHOULD BE AUTOMATIC start of day -> all workers go into the mine. This game just doesn't click for me, it doesn't feel like it has any towerdefense gameplay at all. Its all about managing the mine and maybe 5% going back and building towers. I like to play games in a challenging way, think about how to to play optimaly and get the most out of my situation. You can't do that here without boring yourself to death, the game speed is an issue but the speed up toggle and "fast mode" fix that. The issue instead is that you need to micromanage the mine all-the-time, if you have sped up the time and an enemy spawner "pops up" as they do, when you see it and pause to try and prevent it chances are that you are too late. Because you weren't playing on snail mode. Realistically your options are a) Play slow turtle mode and bore yourself out of your mind while micro managing things and pausing to stop yourself from losing resources. b) Play on fast mode and lose things constantly because you are too slow to react. The micromanagement is not even fun or rewarding, its literaly "a bad thing is going to spawn, I need to tell my guys to destroy it, "a rock is about to spew fire, I need to tell my guys to move", "My drill instructions just go cancelled because it was bedrock behind a rock and now my driller is idle not doing anything, need to right click more stuff". Its not interesting decisionmaking, it just feels like work, I'm not here to work, I'm here to have fun. I guess the players that enjoy this game don't sweat as much about optimising as I do.

The games is a mixture of tower defense and base management. It has a similar vibe as "Ark of Charon". During the day you gather resources via mining and during the night you defend against growing enemy waves. I would give it somewhat a neutral review. The game has a lot of good things - especially considering the price tag - but it also suffers from, what I view, fundamental design flaws. I reached the maximum difficulty and also completed some of the 1% achievements, so I'd say I experienced most of the core game at least. Positives: - The game is fairly easy to understand and play. I didn't have to look for any tutorials or "let's play" to get going. - It has a lot of diversity. You have multiple platforms, cores, specialists, building types, tower types, technologies, distorsions, biomes, mission types ..etc. There is a lot of customisation in both pre-mission and adjustments during mission. - The main loop / core mechanic fits quite well. It can be a bit addictive - which is a mark of a good game - I personally like the aesthetics. Not complex but enough to feel that you are playing a modern game. - I didn't encounter any bugs in 50h of play. Neutral: - I like the idea of progression and upgrades but I dislike the idea of game-changing upgrades. Giving a class of towers 10% more damage is fine. Giving the platform the "Suction ores" ability completly changes your playstyle and you tripple your income from day 1. This makes the upgrade pretty much mandatory but it's pretty far in the tech tree. Negatives: - Probably my biggest complaint would be the extreme micromanagement of workers at night. Generally speaking, you mine during the day and at night you fight. But that's not entirely accurate. Because if you micromanage your workers you can get resources during the night as well. You "just" have to dodge the worms. Which is a very micro-intensive thing to do especially with high worker count. But you lose about 25% income if you don't. This gameplay sucks. You pause every second and reroute X workers. If you mess up you lose the run. High APM should not be a requirement in a colony/tower defense type of game. This is a design flaw. - Workers are just to fragile. When you mine you can unlock a plethora of things that can 1 shot your basic workers even with max upgrades. You just dug up a flamerock? You lost 3 workers. You dug up a boulder? You lost 4 workers. You didn't deny the enemy spawn? Your worker dies before the guards show up to defend. This puts you in a position where you have to dig tile by tile or risk heavy deaths. When you have 30 workers and you have to assign every tile for evey worker it becomes unfun. If you lose 4 workers, your entire income for that day is lost. Especially at high worker count, the cost is pretty significant (one worker is more expensive than the most expensive turret in the game). You spend 95% of the game paused and selecting tiles and 5% running. This is not a good gaming experience. - There are some imabalanced in the game. For example, foundry - which is one of the first buildings - gives you income every turn. The problem is that only the first foundry is worth the cost. All others are a waste of resources as they won't become profitable. This is not complex math. I've seen posts with complains about this in 2024. Yet in 2026 and nothing was done about it. Adjusting some numbers on a basic building is not complicated which makes me believe that there is nobody doing anything about the game balance. Same can be said about other things - like some towers being superior in all scenarios and some being absolute trash. - Your main way of aquiring permanent resources (used in permanent upgrades) is via contracts. The problem is that most contract are to easy and to unrewarding. Even at highest difficulty, I can finish the contracts without buying a single tower (outside of the 2 free ones offered at start). The requirement of completing the mission is to low. So is the reward. So if you want upgrades you end up spamming easy missions basically. The difficult part if at high depths but you never get to that point. There should be contracts that ask the player to go to 1000m (for example) but offer a hefty reward. This would be more engaging gameplay. TLDR Rating: 65 / 100 This could be a 9/10 game with some adjustments but I don't know if anyone works toward that goal.
